newsitem.title: TURKEY: Envoys, Turk officials discuss Iraq oil-food deal.
newsitem.headline: Envoys, Turk officials discuss Iraq oil-food deal.

text.p: Ambassadors of countries in the U.N. Security Council met Turkish Foreign Ministry officials on Thursday to discuss the delayed oil-for-food deal between the U.N. and Iraq and compensating Turkey for related losses, a ministry official told Reuters.
"The meeting was about the implementation of (U.N. Resolution) 986 and seeking ways to recoup losses incurred on Turkey," said the official, who declined to be named.

The United Nations has postponed implementing the plan, which would let Iraq sell oil worth $2 billion over six months to buy humanitarian supplies, until safety for its aid monitors in northern Iraq is assured.
